workData.title: Sotheby's
workData.subTitle: Led the UX/UI design lifecycle at Sotheby’s, integrating user research to drive the strategic roadmap and enhance digital experiences in the luxury market.

content.text: As a Senior Product Designer and Consultant, I joined Sotheby’s product design team to integrate insights from user research, including interviews and analysis, into design strategies. I supported the strategic roadmap and product vision, adapting to the fast-paced auction and luxury goods markets. I also led the entire UX/UI design lifecycle—from research and design to testing and delivery—while ensuring the successful execution of deliverables.

Sotheby’s operates in a highly competitive and fast-evolving market, where continuous innovation and platform improvements are essential. The project’s primary goals were to enhance key functionalities such as payments, accounts, and shipping while maintaining consistent UX/UI across all platforms to deliver a seamless, user-friendly experience.
Integrating user research and usability testing into the design process would result in more user-centric features and increased satisfaction.
Competitive analysis and stakeholder collaboration would support defining objectives and uncovering improvement opportunities.
Iterative design and testing cycles would enhance platform usability, boost user engagement, and reinforce the brand’s digital identity.
Led all stages of the UX/UI design lifecycle, including research, wireframing, prototyping, testing, and delivery.
Collaborated with product managers and stakeholders to define design goals and set clear directions.
Developed personas, user journeys, and scenarios to align with user needs and goals.
Designed low-fidelity system flows, wireframes, and prototypes to quickly validate ideas.
Delivered high-fidelity UI designs and prototypes tailored to devices and screen breakpoints for development teams to implement.
Analyzed user and stakeholder feedback to refine designs and improve usability.
Utilized and contributed to the design system to maintain consistency across platforms.
Collaborated with design leadership to advance UX practices and foster a design-driven culture within the organization.
: Improved user satisfaction and retention with intuitive UX/UI, thorough testing, and enhanced features like payments and accounts.
: Delivered a unified, luxury digital experience across platforms.
: Streamlined workflows and optimized future product development.
: Despite a decline in overall sales from 2021 to 2023, online sales remained higher than pre-pandemic levels.
: Reinforced the role of user-centric design in driving effective solutions.
: Highlighted how teamwork and iteration boost innovation.
: Showcased the importance of agile digital strategies in maintaining relevance and driving growth in a post-pandemic market.
This project demonstrated how strategic leadership and user-centered design create scalable, impactful digital solutions.

workData.title:
Tokyo Disney
Resort App
workData.subTitle: Set a new standard for localized digital experiences with 5M+ downloads and enhanced engagement.

content.text: The Tokyo Disney Resort App is an essential tool for visitors to the resort, beloved by Japanese Disney fans. I served as the lead designer for this project, overseeing app planning, UX/UI design, and art direction. Over the course of a year, I collaborated closely with the creative director from Disney HQ to bring this app to life.

The primary challenge of this project was to seamlessly integrate Disney’s iconic brand identity into a localized product tailored to Japanese users. This required a deep analysis of the cultural and behavioral differences between American and Japanese audiences, ensuring the app design aligned with the preferences and passions of Disney fans in Japan.

The goal was to adapt the US version of the app into a localized product suited to Tokyo Disney Resort, providing a “magical” Disney experience while enhancing convenience and engagement for users. The app aimed to deliver a personalized and immersive experience that would resonate with visitors to the resort.
Customizing the app to reflect the cultural and behavioral traits of Japanese users would improve usability and satisfaction.
A design combining playful elements and immersive experiences would create a memorable impact on Japanese Disney fans.
Innovative features, such as the virtual hotel key, would enhance the user experience and showcase Disney’s attention to detail.

The app’s UI/UX was redesigned to align with the preferences and behaviors of Japanese users, incorporating intuitive navigation and Disney-themed elements to create a design that was both familiar and premium.

To reflect Disney’s identity, playful animations and themed elements were embedded throughout the interface. For example, Mickey’s hand dynamically guided users to their destination, adding a touch of Disney’s whimsy to the experience.
Guests at Disney hotels received a virtual key through the app, with location-based guidance to help them find their rooms. Mickey’s hand provided a fun and dynamic navigation experience.
Upon reaching the door, guests could unlock it with the virtual key, accompanied by magical animations like Cinderella’s dress transformation, delivering a memorable Disney moment.
Each hotel’s virtual key design reflected its unique theme, further immersing guests in Disney’s world.
This combination of functionality and storytelling enhanced the customer experience and brought Disney’s magic to life in a digital format.
: Personalized and immersive features resonated deeply with Japanese Disney fans, ensuring long-term popularity.
: The app successfully combined Disney’s iconic charm with the needs of Japanese users, setting a new standard for localized digital experiences.
: This project highlighted the critical role of understanding cultural traits and user behaviors in creating localized products.
: Thoughtful elements such as themed animations and dynamic navigation significantly enhanced user satisfaction and brand loyalty.
: Working with Disney HQ emphasized the importance of aligning a global brand’s identity with localized user needs to create a successful product.
This project remains a highlight of my career, combining user-centered design, technical innovation, and brand storytelling to create a beloved app for Disney fans.

workData.title:
ANA Mileage
Club App
workData.subTitle: Drove 200% activation growth and 1M+ downloads, enhancing engagement and loyalty.

content.text: As a Senior Product Designer at teamLab, I led the design for the ANA Mileage Club app, a membership service for our client, All Nippon Airways. Collaborating cross-functionally with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing teams, I ensured a cohesive and user-centered design approach.

My responsibilities included branding and product design for the app. I also oversaw the app’s complete design, extending to web design, movie production, and poster design, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience across all touchpoints.

ANA (All Nippon Airways) is a leading airline in Japan, and strives to provide a smooth and enjoyable travel experience. In order to increase customer loyalty and enhance the accessibility of ANA Mileage Club, we introduced a member-only application, ANA Mileage Club. The goal of this project was to develop a dedicated mobile app that would allow ANA Mileage Club members to easily manage their accounts, check their mileage, and conveniently use exclusive services. The app is designed to replace existing plastic cards, allowing members to feel closer to ANA’s program in their daily lives.
This app will enhance customer loyalty, simplify the user experience, and increase interaction with ANA’s services.
We conducted in-depth research to gain a clear understanding of our members’ needs and uncover opportunities to increase participation in the ANA Mileage Club program.

A customized app design was developed to reflect the five membership levels, delivering a tailored user experience for each level. This approach incorporated elements that evoke pride and a subtle sense of exclusivity, enhancing the value of the membership tiers.
Key features such as seamless shopping at the ANA STORE and real-time updates of accumulated mileage were integrated, improving both functionality and convenience for users.

The design visually and intuitively showcases the program’s key features, including mileage, premium points, and ANA SKY Coins. Users can instantly recognize their membership level and track trends in their accumulated rewards at a glance.
The app was optimized to replace traditional plastic cards, enabling members to access all loyalty program functions at airports and affiliated stores directly through their mobile devices.
: Personalized features strengthened members’ connection to ANA Mileage Club, boosting app activation by 200% and driving over 1M downloads.
: Streamlined access to membership benefits, mileage tracking, and shopping enhanced user satisfaction and increased app usage by 75%.
: Modernized the loyalty program with an intuitive, digital-first experience, reinforcing ANA’s commitment to customer satisfaction and innovation.
: Simplifying complex membership data into an intuitive UI highlighted the importance of clear visual communication in enhancing user engagement.
: Optimizing the app as a mobile membership card underscored the effectiveness of digital transformation in replacing physical loyalty systems.
: Tailoring the experience to different membership tiers demonstrated the power of personalized design in increasing customer retention and loyalty.
This project showcased how thoughtful UX/UI design combined with innovative technology can elevate customer engagement, enhance convenience, and modernize brand loyalty.

workData.title:
teamLab Art
Story of the Forest
workData.subTitle: Designed an interactive app for Story of the Forest, enhancing engagement for 8M+ visitors over 8 years.

content.text: Story of the Forest was a permanent exhibition at the National Museum of Singapore from 2016 to October 2024. As a Senior Product Designer at teamLab, I led the design of an accompanying app to enhance visitor engagement, encourage active participation, and elevate the interplay between art, nature, and technology.

This large-scale digital installation transformed the museum’s Glass Rotunda into an immersive environment celebrating Singapore’s native flora and fauna. With a 15-meter-high domed ceiling, a bridge spanning the dome, and a 170-meter passage, visitors embarked on a visually stunning journey that seamlessly blended art, nature, and interactive technology.

The exhibition featured a dynamic environment that evolved from morning to evening and between seasons, allowing visitors to interact with the artwork as animals responded to their presence and the scenery transformed.
We hypothesized that an interactive app would:
Encourage active participation, creating a personalized and engaging experience.
Inspire curiosity about Singapore’s biodiversity through a blend of education and play.
Ensure accessibility for all ages, languages, and cultural backgrounds with a seamless, user-friendly design.

We designed an app that allowed visitors to “capture” virtual plants and animals from the exhibition using their mobile phones. This interactive feature turned their experience into a game-like journey, enabling users to create a personalized digital field guide of the flora and fauna they encountered.
The app blended fun with learning, offering detailed information and sound effects for each captured species. This enhanced engagement while fostering awareness of Singapore’s biodiversity.

With accessibility for all ages in mind, particularly children, the app featured simple navigation, visual cues, and interactive animations to ensure ease of use for visitors from diverse backgrounds.
The app reflected the forest’s serene aesthetics and synchronized with the exhibition’s real-time changes, creating a cohesive and immersive connection between the physical and digital experiences.
: The app encouraged active participation, increasing interaction with the exhibition and deepening the visitor experience.
: Its intuitive design made the exhibition inclusive, reaching diverse audiences and breaking age and language barriers.
: Interactive features fostered curiosity and appreciation for Singapore’s biodiversity, creating meaningful emotional connections.
: Achieving seamless functionality required rigorous testing and fine-tuning of vibrations, animations, and motion detection.
: Observing visitor interactions reinforced the importance of an intuitive, responsive experience in maximizing engagement.
: This project underscored how immersive digital experiences can bridge nature, education, and interactive storytelling.
This exhibition remains a landmark project, merging art, technology, and nature to create an unforgettable, user-driven experience.

workData.title:
SHISEIDO GINZA
SIX store
workData.subTitle: Redefined in-store engagement with an interactive beauty experience for SHISEIDO at GINZA SIX.

content.text: When GINZA SIX, a luxury shopping mall in Tokyo’s Ginza district, opened, Shiseido introduced an innovative interactive digital interface in their store. As a designer at teamLab, I served as the lead designer for this project, overseeing UX/UI design and art direction.

The goal of this project was to provide a personalized, interactive experience targeted at young women in their 20s, combining beauty consultation with product exploration. To achieve this, we introduced Japan’s first Digital Counseling Mirror and placed a front-facing interface to display information about new products and enhance customer engagement.

Shiseido sought to redefine cosmetics shopping by combining personal consultation, product exploration, and digital interaction. The Digital Counseling Mirror allowed customers to view themselves while exploring product details, blending functionality with aesthetics.
The front-facing interface provided real-time product information triggered by proximity or product interaction, seamlessly integrating engagement and discovery to enhance the in-store experience.
Interactive features would personalize the experience and boost customer engagement.
Intuitive design would appeal to young women in their 20s.
High-quality visuals would build trust and reflect Shiseido’s innovative and elegant brand.

We designed a front-facing digital interface that played product videos by default but dynamically displayed detailed product information and usage instructions when customers approached or interacted with the products. This ensured an engaging and seamless experience while highlighting new offerings.

The Digital Counseling Mirror allowed customers to see their reflection while exploring product options, combining practicality with innovation. By carefully testing and selecting the ideal display, we ensured the screen functioned as both a high-quality mirror and an interactive touch panel.

To cater to Shiseido’s target audience of young women, we created an intuitive interface with simple navigation, clear graphics, and engaging animations. The system prioritized ease of use while maintaining a premium aesthetic aligned with Shiseido’s brand.
We focused on accurately rendering product textures, colors, and effects on-screen, replicating their real-life appearance to build customer trust and confidence in their purchasing decisions.
: The interactive interfaces encouraged customers to explore products more actively, creating a memorable and personalized shopping experience.
: The Digital Counseling Mirror and front-facing display showcased Shiseido’s commitment to blending classic elegance with cutting-edge technology, setting a new standard for the cosmetics industry.
: The intuitive design and interactive features ensured ease of use for a wide audience, especially young women.

: Finding a display that functioned as both a touch panel and a realistic mirror required extensive testing and iteration, highlighting the importance of thorough experimentation in solving complex design challenges.
: Observing how users interacted with the system emphasized the value of intuitive, responsive design for increasing engagement and satisfaction.
: This project underscored the importance of harmonizing aesthetics and usability to create innovative, brand-aligned experiences.
This project remains a career highlight, combining technology, art, and user-centric design to transform the in-store cosmetics experience.

workData.title:
FLIGHT OF
DREAMS
workData.subTitle: Redefined the airport experience with 4M+ visitors and 3M+ app downloads.

content.text: Flight of Dreams was an aviation-themed experience that operated from October 12, 2018, to March 31, 2021. Centered on the Boeing 787 Dreamliner, it combined commerce, exhibitions, and entertainment. This collaboration between teamLab and Chubu Centrair International Airport used a full-scale Boeing 787 and cutting-edge digital technology to offer immersive experiences.
The project earned the 2019 Good Design Award for its innovative integration of commerce, exhibitions, and entertainment.
I led the UX/UI design and project management for the accompanying app, transforming the airport from a “transit hub” into a destination for learning and entertainment.

Flight of Dreams offered a large-scale aviation-themed entertainment space in a public airport, creating a unique experience for families, aviation enthusiasts, and visitors. It aimed to inspire wonder about aviation while blending education and entertainment.
Flight Park, designed by teamLab, combined interactive digital content with a full-scale aircraft display, helping visitors explore airplane manufacturing, aviation careers, and flight principles.
Interactive app features like quizzes and part-collection activities would boost visitor engagement.
Airports could be transformed into destinations offering learning and entertainment.
Integrating digital technology with physical spaces would create engaging, stimulating experiences.
Teaching visitors about airplane manufacturing and the aviation industry.
Encouraging visitors to explore the Boeing 787, collect parts, and complete a virtual encyclopedia.
Promoting exploration of the facility, blending physical and digital experiences.
A full-scale aircraft combined with advanced technology turned the airport into an accessible entertainment destination, adding learning and fun to its traditional role.
Welcomed over 500,000 visitors in 100 days and 1 million in 232 days, attracting 1.6 million annually during its operation.
: Received the 2019 Good Design Award for its innovative approach.
: The app and exhibits successfully combined education and entertainment, offering fresh aviation insights.
: Turned the airport into a destination for unique experiences beyond transit.
: Digital technology can redefine public spaces and create unique value.
: Designs that spark curiosity and active participation effectively engage diverse visitors.
: Combining full-scale aircraft with interactive technology demonstrated the power of innovative ideas.
This project showcased how blending technology, education, and entertainment can create immersive experiences and redefine public spaces.

workData.title: coe
workData.subTitle: Designed the brand and UX/UI for coe, enabling AI-driven human rights risk analysis to drive corporate accountability.

content.text: In response to the growing focus on “Business and Human Rights,” coe launched a service to eliminate human rights violations by capturing workers’ voices and assessing corporate human rights risks.
Using AI, coe analyzes data from internal and external sources to uncover hidden risks, evaluate severity, and prioritize improvements, streamlining human rights due diligence for companies.

As the Lead Product Designer from the project’s inception, I created the brand design system, service-related designs, and UX/UI for web and app interfaces. Currently, I continue to enhance features and develop new functionalities to ensure coe evolves into an essential platform that empowers workers, transforms corporate behavior, and contributes to a better world.

coe provides a platform for workers to anonymously and safely report workplace concerns. It addresses challenges like hesitance to use company consultation channels by offering a secure and user-friendly solution.
: Ensures workers can safely share concerns.
: Identifies human rights risks and prioritizes solutions.
: Provides content to raise awareness and support learning.
A secure, intuitive platform will encourage workers to participate and share concerns.
AI-powered analysis will help companies address issues efficiently.
A trustworthy brand design will build confidence among workers and companies.
A cohesive design system emphasizing transparency and trust was created to engage workers and companies alike.
The interfaces were designed for simplicity, anonymity, and ease of use, with secure messaging and educational content to enhance engagement.
AI analyzes worker feedback, delivering actionable risk assessments to help companies prioritize improvements.

: AI-enabled companies to identify and address risks effectively.
: Educational content fostered understanding of human rights issues.
: A reliable design system earned credibility with workers and companies.
: Anonymity and safety were key to encouraging participation.
: AI-powered insights streamlined communication and problem-solving.

coe continues to amplify workers’ voices and drive corporate transformation. As lead designer, I remain dedicated to refining features and adding value to support its mission.

workData.subTitle: Designed an innovative website for SOUND ON LIVE, translating music into dynamic visuals for an immersive, inspiring experience.

workData.title: AuthPay
workData.subTitle: Led design and branding for AuthPay, an AI-powered smart wallet, driving personalized experiences, user engagement, and scalable growth.

content.text: AuthPay is an AI-powered smart wallet that transforms the payment experience in restaurants, bars, and cafes. It automatically selects the most optimal payment method for each transaction, maximizing rewards for customers while offering personalized dining experiences based on food preferences and past orders.

As the Lead Product Designer, I led UX/Product Design, Visual Design, Design System, Mobile Design, Web Design, and Branding, contributing to the development of AuthPay’s user experience and cohesive brand identity.
AuthPay integrates NFC tags with POS systems to provide a seamless order and payment process, enhancing revenue and customer loyalty through personalized recommendations and smart upselling.
AI-driven payment optimization will maximize customer rewards and satisfaction.
Personalized dining experiences will strengthen customer loyalty and encourage repeat visits.
A simple onboarding process will support fast adoption by businesses.
Block Convey’s data integration will enhance security and scalability for long-term growth.
AI automatically selects the best payment method for each transaction, maximizing customer rewards.
Tailored menu recommendations and smart upselling based on customer preferences and past orders.
NFC tag installation and POS integration are completed within a week to enable fast implementation.
Contactless ordering and payments via NFC tags, with QR codes as a backup option for all devices.
NFC tag designs are tailored to match the venue’s interior, enhancing brand identity and customer experience.
: Personalized recommendations and optimized rewards improved customer satisfaction and loyalty.
: Smart upselling and tailored services led to higher average order values and customer retention.
: Leveraging Block Convey’s decentralized data stack ensured secure, scalable data management and future growth.
: The partnership enabled expanded data-driven services and user-centric solutions.
: Personalized experiences drive customer engagement and encourage repeat visits.

This project showcased how AI-powered payment optimization and personalized services enhance customer experiences and drive business growth. As the Lead Product Designer, I continue to support AuthPay’s growth and innovation.

workData.title: btwn
workData.subTitle: Led B2B & B2C product design, branding, and UX/UI for btwn, a referral-based marketing platform, increasing engagement with +65% MAUs and 5K+ downloads.

content.text: btwn is an innovative promotional platform transforming referral marketing with a cashback system that benefits both businesses and consumers. By incentivizing word-of-mouth marketing, btwn enhances customer engagement, strengthens brand loyalty, and increases revenue for partner businesses.

As the Lead Product Designer, I led the end-to-end design strategy, overseeing brand direction, corporate identity, UX/UI design, and the development of both the B2B dashboard and B2C app. My role was to create a cohesive and user-friendly experience across all digital touchpoints, ensuring that businesses and consumers could seamlessly interact with the platform.

btwn empowers businesses by providing a network that drives sales and customer retention through word-of-mouth referrals. Consumers play an active role in marketing by earning cashback rewards when referring friends.
Businesses join btwn and create a profile.
Consumers access these profiles via the app and visit partner businesses.
Consumers refer friends, and when their referrals make purchases, they earn cashback rewards.
Automated technology tracks referrals and ensures seamless reward distribution.
A user-friendly, visually engaging platform will drive participation from both businesses and consumers.
Word-of-mouth marketing will be more effective in increasing sales and loyalty than traditional paid advertising.
I designed and implemented a holistic digital experience that seamlessly connected businesses and consumers:
: Created an intuitive interface allowing businesses to manage referrals, track customer engagement, and optimize their marketing strategies.
: Developed an engaging, easy-to-use app that lets consumers participate in referral programs, track rewards, and discover partner businesses.
: Designed promotional content, ensuring branding consistency across social media, blogs, and print materials.
Established a consistent, user-friendly tone aligned with btwn’s mission of empowering businesses and consumers.
Developed a seamless onboarding experience to ensure effortless adoption for new users.

workData.title: Astream
workData.subTitle: Redesigned Astream, Japan’s first SNS marketing tool, into a seamless platform adopted by 1,500+ businesses with 99% customer satisfaction and expansion across seven Asian countries.

content.text: I led the product design for the service renewal of Astream, Japan’s first SNS marketing tool leveraging psychographic analysis. The goal was to transform the service into a streamlined platform where users could efficiently identify the best influencers for strategic marketing.

Astream manages over 2 million account profiles from platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and X. The challenge was to organize this vast amount of data into an intuitive system that helps users discover influencers efficiently.
Simplified and strategic search pathways would help users navigate large datasets and select optimal influencers.
Redefining key features and presenting data clearly would enhance user engagement and decision-making.
Iterative UX improvements would lead to a more seamless and effective user journey.
I reorganized search priorities and key features to ensure a logical flow that connects users’ actions from influencer search to performance measurement.
I developed a clear and user-friendly interface that simplified the presentation of complex data, making influencer selection intuitive.
Through multiple rounds of user testing, I continuously refined the designs to improve the overall experience and ensure the system met user needs effectively.
: Users could efficiently navigate over 2 million profiles to identify the best influencers.
: A seamless flow from search to performance measurement provided a smoother experience.
: Clear data presentation enabled users to make informed marketing decisions.
: In 2024, Astream achieved the highest SaaS NPS in Japan and expanded its influencer marketing services to seven countries across Asia.
: Presenting complex datasets in an intuitive way significantly improves user engagement.
: Iterative user testing is essential for achieving an optimal user journey.
: Redefining features based on user behaviors ensures the platform aligns with their goals.

This project demonstrated the value of combining data organization with thoughtful design to create a highly efficient marketing tool. Astream’s success reflects its ability to address user needs while achieving measurable impact across the industry.

The challenge was to unify the brand’s visual identity and improve the user experience of their e-commerce platform to better align with the company’s vision and target audience.
A consistent and well-defined design direction would strengthen the brand’s identity and improve customer recognition.

I overhauled the UI/UX of their e-commerce platform, ensuring a seamless and engaging shopping experience that aligned with the new brand identity.
I developed a comprehensive social media strategy, updating content and imagery to create a cohesive online presence that aligned with the brand’s voice and vision.
I directed advertisement photography and filming, ensuring all visuals consistently reflected the brand’s identity and vision.

workData.title:
ONLIVE
Studio/blog

ONLINE Studio was designed to connect music production professionals with those who need their expertise, encouraging creative collaboration. The platform was structured to allow users to easily create projects and receive support from professionals.

Simplifying project creation and consultation features would improve user accessibility and promote collaboration.

This project successfully enhanced collaboration in the music community by building trust, encouraging creativity, and delivering an exceptional user experience.

workData.title: FRONT-END.AI
workData.subTitle: Led UX/UI for FRONT-END.AI, an AI-powered tool automating design-to-code conversion, cutting development time and reducing business costs.

content.text: As the Lead UX/UI Designer for FRONT-END.AI, I developed a service that automates the conversion of design compositions (JPEG, PNG, or JSON files) into code, aiming to streamline workflows for coders with 1-5 years of experience by drastically reducing the time and effort needed to prepare design pages.
FRONT-END.AI was designed to offer an efficient tool for junior and mid-level coders, addressing pain points in the design-to-code workflow.

The service leverages patented AI technology in Japan and the U.S. to analyze design compositions and automatically generate coding suggestions (e.g., HTML, CSS), reducing initial coding time by 85%. Companies using this tool reported annual cost savings of up to 10 million yen by eliminating external outsourcing.
Additionally, FRONT-END.AI received industry recognition, including:
2021: Jury Award and Tokai Tokyo Securities Award at The JSSA Online Startup Pitch Award, hosted by the Japan Startup Support Association.
2019: Sakura Internet Award at B Dash Camp Fall 2019 in Fukuoka’s Pitch Arena.
Automating the design-to-code process will significantly reduce workload, save time, and lower costs.
Collecting and incorporating user feedback will ensure alignment with actual coder needs, increasing satisfaction.
A clear, intuitive UI/UX design system will drive adoption and improve functionality.

Developed an intuitive interface to simplify the process of converting design compositions into code.
Conducted user feedback sessions post-launch to gather insights on functionality and preferences.
Introduced essential features based on feedback to meet user needs effectively.
Leveraged user testing results to enhance the service’s practicality, usability, and functionality.
Reduced initial coding time by 85%, significantly improving coder productivity.
Enabled businesses to save up to 10 million yen annually by cutting external outsourcing costs.
Enhanced user satisfaction through continuous refinement and patented AI technology.
Gained industry recognition with awards from The JSSA Online Startup Pitch Award and B Dash Camp.
Direct user feedback is crucial for identifying essential features and refining product functionality.
Iterative design and rapid feature updates are key to creating a practical, user-aligned tool.
A clear and intuitive UI/UX design system is vital for driving adoption and satisfaction.
This project demonstrated how AI-driven tools can streamline workflows, save costs, and enhance user experiences through user-centered design and continuous iteration.

workData.title: Bunshi Lab
workData.subTitle: Revamped Bunshi Mask’s e-commerce site, enhancing brand trust and usability, driving 300K+ unit sales across 160+ medical facilities.

content.text: In early 2021, I joined Bunshi Mask as a UX/UI Designer to revamp their e-commerce site during the COVID-19 pandemic. The client aimed to establish a premium brand identity by showcasing their unique materials and technology, standing out in a competitive market.

workData.title: Who'z
workData.subTitle: Built a platform for teams to create and embed personalized web pages, enhancing small business visibility and recruitment.

content.text: As a Senior Product Designer for Who’z, I led the creation of a user-friendly platform designed to help employees and teams create and manage personalized web pages. Serving as a talent management tool and cloud service, Who’z simplifies the process of creating, managing, and embedding employee and team profiles into existing websites.

The platform focuses on enhancing team visibility, building trust, and improving recruitment efforts, making it particularly valuable for small businesses seeking to promote their talent and team capabilities.

The core functionalities of Who’z include member management, team management, and profile customization. Its goal is to simplify the creation of employee introduction pages that can be embedded or shared, enabling businesses to effectively promote their teams.

workData.title: Will TAP
workData.subTitle: Developed a smart home app for luxury apartments in Japan, achieving 80% adoption with an intuitive and seamless user experience.

content.text: As the Senior Product Designer for Will TAP, a smart home app tailored for residents of Nomura Real Estate’s Proud apartments in Japan, I worked to create a seamless and user-friendly interface that allows residents to control smart home devices and receive essential notifications. The app also offers additional features designed to enhance the convenience and quality of life for apartment residents.
The goal was to balance diverse functionalities with intuitive design, ensuring accessibility for all users while integrating smoothly with smart home systems.

Will TAP was developed as a comprehensive smart home solution for Proud apartment residents, offering a wide range of features to improve daily living. The main challenge was managing the complexity of these features while ensuring ease of use and smooth device integration.
: Remote control and monitoring of locks, security settings, and select appliances (e.g., air conditioning, lighting, heating, floor heating).
: Reservation system for shared facilities and access to a digital library for equipment manuals and various application forms.
: Access to community-related information, events, and shared spaces through a dedicated member web portal.
: Alerts for lock/unlock status, parcel deliveries, management announcements, and shared space reservation updates.
: Family and appliance management, operation history, personal settings, and access to management rules.
The app is currently implemented in Proud City Hiyoshi and will be introduced to additional Proud series properties in the future.
Organizing the app’s diverse functionalities into intuitive categories would improve usability and encourage adoption.

point 0
marunouchi
workData.subTitle: Designed a premium website and intuitive app for a next-gen co-working space, driving 2x member growth, 3.8x individual sign-ups, and Japan’s first WELL Certification.

content.text: point 0 marunouchi is a co-working space launched in July 2019, redefining the “future of office spaces” by integrating advanced technologies and supporting diverse working styles.

As the Product Designer for point 0 marunouchi, I designed the website and app to reflect the space’s high-end, futuristic concept while providing a seamless user experience. The app included features such as reservations, payments, announcements, and location services, catering to the needs of busy professionals.

point 0 marunouchi offers a unique co-working experience with open spaces, meeting rooms, and nap booths equipped with cutting-edge solutions. Leveraging advanced data collection and biometrics, the space continuously improves its offerings through analysis and experimentation.

In January 2021, it became the first co-working office in Japan to earn WELL Certification (WELL v2 pilot) at the Gold level. This achievement was made possible through partnerships with Okamura Corporation, Daikin Industries, and Panasonic, incorporating expertise in air quality, furniture, and lighting.

As a testbed for WORKTECH innovations, point 0 marunouchi hosts unique experiments and initiatives led by 17 participating companies, including Daikin, Okamura, Panasonic, TOTO, Asahi, Epson, Microsoft, and Sony. Starting with 10 committee members at launch, this network quickly expanded within a year.
A user-friendly website and app design would align with the space’s premium and innovative concept.
Intuitive app features, such as reservations and location services, would enhance user engagement and satisfaction.
Highlighting advanced technologies and high-end solutions would position point 0 marunouchi as a leading workspace for professionals.

workData.title:
Pocket Change
Poke Pay
workData.subTitle: Delivered seamless currency exchange experiences through branding, web, and kiosk UX/UI, driving a 140% sales increase.

content.text: “Pocket Change” is an innovative technology company revolutionizing foreign currency exchange with kiosks installed across Japan. These kiosks allow users to exchange foreign currency, recharge transportation IC cards, and convert leftover balances into points or e-money for other services.

As the Lead Product Designer, I developed the company’s branding, corporate identity, design system, and website. I also designed intuitive, multilingual interfaces for the kiosks to ensure accessibility for a diverse, international user base.

Pocket Change aimed to simplify foreign currency exchange by providing a seamless solution for travelers, while expanding its range of services with e-money and voucher partnerships worldwide. By focusing on user accessibility and convenience, the company sought to position itself as the go-to currency exchange service in Japan.
: Accepts 10 different currencies, with plans for further expansion.
: Offers a wide variety of global options, including PayPal, WeChat, Rakuten, and Amazon Gift Certificates, along with public transportation e-money like Rakuten Edy, WAON, and nanaco.
: Allows users to donate leftover currency to organizations like UNICEF.
: 80 kiosks installed nationwide, including major airports in Japan.
